chunks: And do not withhold from people what belongs to them, and do not corrupt the land;

key_terms.تَبْخَسُوا: Withhold or give less than due

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to not withhold people's rights and not corrupt the earth?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse follows the narrative of Prophet Shu'ayb, emphasizing that economic justice is a core component of prophetic mission. Shia scholarship highlights 'not diminishing' (tabkhus) as a comprehensive principle covering both weight/measurement and rights, while 'corruption on earth' (mufsideen) extends beyond physical destruction to include social and moral decay.
